title: adiantum hewardia
intro: Adiantum hewardia, commonly known as the maidenhair fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Pteridaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Asian medicine, where it is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Adiantum hewardia include its anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antibacterial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, boost the immune system, and fight off infections.
